description: This file declares wrapper classes for OMXNode interface in Android's media stagefright component, including legacy and Treble wrappers, with class definitions and method signatures for OMX node operations.

classes.name: LWOmxNode
classes.description: Legacy wrapper class for OMXNode, providing methods to interact with OMX node instances.

classes.name: TWOmxNode
classes.description: Treble wrapper class for OMXNode, providing HIDL interface methods for OMX node operations.

methods.name: freeNode
methods.description: Releases or frees the OMX node.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the OMX node.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter from the OMX node.

methods.name: setParameter
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the OMX node.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data from the OMX node.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration data on the OMX node.

methods.name: setPortMode
methods.description: Configures the port mode of the OMX node.

methods.name: prepareForAdaptivePlayback
methods.description: Prepares the OMX node for adaptive playback.

methods.name: setInputSurface
methods.description: Sets the input surface for the OMX node.

methods.name: useBuffer
methods.description: Uses a buffer with the OMX node.

methods.name: getExtensionIndex
methods.description: Retrieves extension index for a parameter.

methods.name: dispatchMessage
methods.description: Dispatches a message to the OMX node.
